record.title: China’s central science-industry integration opinion directs enterprise-led research and AI+ deployment
record.summary: On Oct 21, 2026, China’s CPC Central Committee General Office and State Council General Office issued an opinion on deeper integration of science and industrial innovation. The text calls for enterprise-led applied research projects, staged funding and milestone evaluation, technology-transfer mechanisms, demonstration scenarios, broader private-enterprise access to research facilities and data, and full implementation of AI+ across industries. This record covers the issued policy and its stated mechanisms; it does not establish implementation, dedicated budgets, adoption or measured effects.
organizations: Chinese Communist Party Central Committee General Office
Ministry of Science and Technology of China
